title: Do not wait with sleep — use click's --expect-url · --expect-text
symptom: A fixed wait such as sleep 5 follows the click, then web text checks the result. Slow screens get read before they change; fast screens waste time. Sometimes expect_not_met appears
cause: Given --expect-url · --expect-text, web click waits until it appears (--timeout seconds) and reports expect_not_met if it does not. Without them it waits only briefly (a few seconds). web type waits by itself up to --timeout for the field to appear
fix: launch_cli.py web click --ref <number> --expect-text <text on the next screen> --timeout 30
launch_cli.py web click --ref <number> --expect-url <part of the new URL>
On expect_not_met, read the current screen with web text — if you pressed the wrong thing, pick again with web find
--selector on web text · assert does not wait — if you will read right away, wait first with click's expect
